evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies `src/interfaces/mining.h` and `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp` to fix a template data race and introduce `interfaces::Block`.
rationale: Resolves a multithreaded data race on `CBlockTemplate` members during concurrent solution submission and template reads (#36515). External mining consumers like Stratum v2 template providers require stability across concurrent worker threads when reading templates and submitting solutions.
